fixed: On the treadmill the mascot hung in the air in a sitting shape: a run plants its feet where it lands, so held on the spot its legs stretched out; the feet now move back with him and he runs on the belt, side-on.
The burger-shaped puffs were tiny and came out over his face; they are bigger and come out of his mouth.
The water drops and the gas bubbles were too faint on the yellow oil; they have strong edges now.
The lungs' barbell lifted behind the 2.9 KG label; the lungs sit lower in the frame and the barbell shows under it.
The soda glass was small, under the captions, and gone a moment after its word; it is big at the top right and stays into the next shot, fading as the camera flies on.
notes: One journey, Biku's script as written: the lungs lifting a tiny barbell (2.9 KG of oxygen per kilo of fat); into the oil, the fat molecule snapping apart and oxygen flying in to join each piece; water drops and carbon dioxide bubbles, the soda fizzing with the same bubbles; out through the cell and the belly into the blood, grey gas riding it to the lungs; up the windpipe and out of the mouth into the bathroom as a big breath cloud (840 G BREATHED OUT); a drop of sweat and the toilet (160 G LEAVES AS WATER); the gym, burger-shaped breaths from the treadmill. Measured: never empty, never still.
